key.name: max-folders
key.description: How many recently used folders to show in the sidebar.

key.name: skip-sidebar-folders
key.summary: Skip folders already in the sidebar
key.description: Leave out the home folder and folders you bookmarked yourself, since the sidebar shows them anyway.

key.name: hidden-folders
key.description: Recent folders removed from the sidebar by the user; they are not shown again.

key.name: dock-jump-lists
key.description: Add pinned and recent files or folders to the right-click menu of apps in the dock.

key.name: jump-list-items
key.description: How many recent files or folders a jump list shows, not counting pinned ones.

key.name: jump-list-pins
key.description: For each app (by desktop file ID), the URIs pinned to its jump list, in the order they were pinned.

key.name: jump-list-removed
key.description: For each app (by desktop file ID), the URIs removed from its jump list; they are not shown in it again.
